title: Adds address validation errors for CMRAs and registered agents to Accounts v1 and Accounts v2
summary: Adds two values to the [requirements.errors[].code](https://docs.stripe.com/api/accounts/object.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive#account_object-requirements-errors-code) and [future_requirements.errors[].code](https://docs.stripe.com/api/accounts/object.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive#account_object-future_requirements-errors-code) enum properties on v1 objects, and to the [requirements.entries[].errors[].code](https://docs.stripe.com/api/v2/core/accounts/object.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive#v2_account_object-requirements-entries-errors-code) and [future_requirements.entries[].errors[].code](https://docs.stripe.com/api/v2/core/accounts/object.md?api-version=2026-09-30.endive#v2_account_object-future_requirements-entries-errors-code) enum properties on v2 Accounts: Integrations that read requirement error codes from Accounts v1 or Accounts v2 can now receive invalid_address_cmra_address and invalid_address_registered_agent_address. If your code uses strict enum matching or doesn’t handle unknown error codes, it can fail when it encounters these values.

migrationNotes.text: If your integration reads requirement errors from a v1 Account, a v1 Bank Account, a v1 Capability, a v1 Person, or a v2 Account, update its error-handling logic to support invalid_address_cmra_address and invalid_address_registered_agent_address. Review address validation for commercial compliance for integration guidance.

sources.quote: | [Adds address validation errors for CMRAs and registered agents to Accounts v1 and Accounts v2](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive/2026-09-30/address-validation-cmra-registered-agents-accounts-v2.md) | Issuing, Treasury | Breaking | api |

Integrations that read requirement error codes from Accounts v1 or Accounts v2 can now receive `invalid_address_cmra_address` and `invalid_address_registered_agent_address`. If your code uses strict enum matching or doesn’t handle unknown error codes, it can fail when it encounters these values.
